name: IC 1495
observing_summary: Two consecutive IAC80/CAMELOT2 sequences: 26 × 250 s in R on 2025 October 13 and 35 × 300 s in V on 2025 October 14.
reference_note: Three numbered field stars were used for differential photometry. The working magnitudes adopted in the reductions are R = 13.994, 15.374, 13.489 and V = 14.544, 15.816, 13.876 for stars 1–3, respectively.
validation_note: The numbering and R/V values follow the supplied IC 1495 finding chart and the IAC80 photometry working sequence. The J2000 comparison-star coordinates and catalogue uncertainties will be added from the original comparison-star table when that table is available to the repository workflow.
photometry_system_note: The R and V magnitudes listed here are the working comparison-star values used for the IC 1495 IAC80 reductions. Catalogue-coordinate provenance and magnitude uncertainties will be added from the original comparison-star table.
extra_note: The supplied static chart identifies stars 1–3 and lists the adopted V magnitudes.
